gates.detail: Marking side: every pattern of this job is drawn as seen from the OUTSIDE of the formed part (pattern normal toward the outside). Spec 02 §0.3 requires a declared marking side but does not choose one; this side follows from the frames the specification writes down (§4.1, §4.4) and is a PROVISIONAL convention declared by the software. It has not been reviewed by a fabrication engineer. Marking a pattern on the other face mirrors the part (misfit of tens of millimetres for an offset, oblique branch). An engineer must confirm the marking side before use. Surface reference declared by the user as 'outside'. The declaration is recorded, not checked against a drawing. Contact and development radii were checked against the declared surface (Spec 02 §6.1): the direction is possible; no wall thickness is modelled, so its size is not checked. header_dev_radius = 150 equals the outside contact radius header_radius = 150: that is a wall of zero thickness (an idealised surface). Thickness is not modelled; an engineer must confirm the radii before use. branch_dev_radius = 100 equals the outside contact radius branch_radius = 100: that is a wall of zero thickness (an idealised surface). Thickness is not modelled; an engineer must confirm the radii before use.
